propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY has a producer (SSM slot) and transport (env file injection) but zero runtime consumers; no application code reads the variable.

The documented purpose of MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY (verdict signing) was superseded by asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates per ADR 0049; current verdict signing uses the op-cert Ed25519 key, not any HMAC secret.
Removing the secret is safe and incompatible only with pre-ADR-0049 rollbacks; current supported paths are unaffected.
Retention of the secret imposes ongoing operator toil (provisioning, KMS storage, rotation) with zero security effect and creates audit/documentation confusion about active HMAC signing.
Atomic removal requires coordinated deletion across six tracked files: terraform slot declaration, two script references, and three documentation/runbook mentions.
